trigger: Core Record activated with all five memories
note: Reuses stills from other cutscenes; no new art required. Extra Voss lines explain the stand-down (text-only where VO would mismatch).

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Core Record opens. Ten thousand years of light pour into the command channel.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Enough. Show me what you found — before this kills another station.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Kaela opens every memory on his channel: the war they refused, the vote to merge into Gaia, the fear beside the hope — and the child in the woods whose mind became the key.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I thought she was Station Seven again — a lattice that wakes and eats a colony. I was hunting software.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: This is a people who asked to stay. They chose peace over a winnable war. They merged so their sun could not erase them. Your mind is their lock — not a weapon I can purge.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Stand down. All units, stand down.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Station Seven was a wound. This… this is a people. I was wrong about what they were. I will not erase a civilization to quiet my fear.

lines.speaker: GAIA
lines.text: Thank you for choosing. The colony will feel me — gently. I promise to learn their fear.

panels.then: title card GAIA REMEMBERS over the upper sky
